The '''Reithcas sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The sector was the location of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bortras]], where [[Jorus C'baoth]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
